findings.claim: CARRIED, UNRESOLVED. The Q1 rationale still asserts a contradiction the passage does not contain: publisher provenance and publisher production do not exclude teacher authorship, so “Texten motsäger det ändå två gånger” is an invalid inference presented as fact in the teaching payload.

CLEAN — the strongest available attack on the new wording, prosecuted independently and defeated. Hostile reading: “Det” in ”Det är svårt att komma ifrån.” binds the essayist's OWN ¶3 pattern-claim, turning the sentence into a reassertion (’there is no getting away from the pattern’) rather than a concession of Bråtemo's objection — which would leave the objection contested and arguably reopen Q2/D. Four independent grounds kill it. (1) Binding: the bare sentential anaphor takes the immediately preceding, maximally salient proposition — Bråtemo's “ingen vet vad läraren faktiskt sade” — and reaching ¶3's thesis requires skipping the whole paragraph-so-far with no forcing context; the reassertion idiom is moreover almost always realised with an explicit complement (”det är svårt att komma ifrån ATT …”), and the complement-less form directly after a reported objection reads as concession. (2) Discourse: the next sentence opens with adversative “Men” and pivots INTO thesis-supporting material (“bilderna förändras i takt med texterna”); that only parses if the preceding sentence conceded — under the reassertion reading “Men” would pivot from thesis to thesis, which is incoherent. (3) Frame: ¶4 opens “Bråtemo tycker att jag läser in för mycket”, establishing an objection–response paragraph whose only coherent arc is report–concede–counter. (4) IMMATERIALITY, the decisive layer: even granting the hostile parse arguendo, “ingen vet vad läraren faktiskt sade när dörren var stängd” stands unrebutted under every reading — the “Men” counter concludes “avsiktlig”, i.e. producer intent, never classroom practice — and ¶2's one-marginal-date-in-83 stands; so Q2/D dies regardless of anaphor resolution, and Q2/A never crosses onto the practice side. My grounds (2) and (4) converge with the fresh G-DISTRACTOR leg's independent dismissal of its own counsel case; ground (1) is additional to it.

CLEAN — no other hostile reading enabled by the change. (a) Locomotive sense (’svårt att komma ifrån’ = hard to get away from a place/engagement): no travel or schedule frame exists anywhere in ¶4; not viable. (b) Truncated-complement garden path (reader awaits an att-clause that never comes): Swedish fully licenses the raised sentential-object reading; momentary at worst, no key consequence. (c) Strength shift: ’komma ifrån’ (cannot deny) is if anything a STRONGER concession than ’komma runt’ (cannot circumvent) — which strengthens the refutation of Q2/D and cannot hurt Q2/A, whose claim lives entirely on the design side that the essay reasserts after “Men”; a fortiori it cannot touch Q1, which keys on ¶3's exception sentence, whose corpus counts Bråtemo's objection never contests. (d) Lexical surface: ’ifrån’ occurs nowhere else in the unit's student-facing text, so no new echo or bridge is created.
